response: first-inning runs scored by batting team in each half-inning

fitting.schedule: refit once per calendar month using only strictly earlier same-season complete games; score entire target date before adding outcomes
fitting.standardization: training half-innings only; mean/std; std floor 1e-9
fitting.optimizer: IRLS Newton with exact dense Hessian

probability.independence_assumption: conditional half-inning run counts treated independent given admitted pregame predictors

selection.side_rule: NRFI if p>=0.75; YRFI if p<=0.25; otherwise abstain

tuning: single frozen configuration; no feature subset grid, lambda search, threshold search, interaction search or post-result calibration
external: historical-seen development only; no pristine external claim; no external open unless gate passes under separately authorized future protocol
